case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You are working with tight capacity, and what helps you most is a binding volume you can plan around. Option A gives you that: a firm annual volume over a long contract term, with a lead time that fits your scheduling.

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to the full volume for the whole term, and the claims below show why the price sits where it does.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.98; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

For your pricing committee or management, the case is simple: Option A secures the full volume and long-term planning with us, with no need to chase additional volumes order by order. We would be grateful if you would take Option A to them as it stands.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer stands at a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your cost and quality data have been verified but warrant only a marginal adjustment. We agree to the volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term. 

Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We meet the agreed quality targets. Which volume can you commit to? Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for setting out your final offer so clearly. We accept your alternative proposal as you offered it, and we are glad the volume and the contract term are settled between us.

You asked which volume we can commit to. We commit to the full binding volume for the whole term, so you can plan your tight capacity around it with confidence.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

This is the package we can approve, and it gives you a firm volume and long-term planning with us. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your acceptance of our alternative pricing structure. We agree to the Lieferzeit of 56 days at the price of €31.70 per unit for the volume of 23400 pcs per year and a contract term of 36 months. We can accept your terms and await your order. Please issue the formal purchase order to conclude this agreement. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This Angebot stays valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
